create_cider_scorer: create a CiderScorer instance with reference captions and test hypotheses to compute CIDEr scores
compute_cider_score: compute CIDEr similarity scores between generated captions and reference captions using TF-IDF vectors
cook_refs_captions: cook reference sentences into ngram frequency representations for CIDEr scoring
cook_test_sentence: cook a test hypothesis sentence into an ngram frequency vector for CIDEr comparison
add_cider_instances: add multiple CiderScorer instances or caption-reference tuples to accumulate scores across batches
